data.exact_reserve_text: Claims incurred, net of reinsurance, totalled GBP 308.2 million during the calendar year (2014: GBP 257.2 million). This includes an amount of GBP 33.6 million in respect of increases to reserves on 2013 and prior underwriting years (2014: GBP 26.8 million in respect of reserve releases from 2012 and prior underwriting years).

prior_year_events.event_name: Incoming reinsurance to close of the 2012 year of account
prior_year_events.impact_description: Included within the 2013 underwriting year result was a profit of GBP 34.7m on business transacted in prior years inherited through the incoming reinsurance to close of the 2012 year of account (favourable prior year development on inherited business).

data.standardized_narrative: At the 2015 year-end Syndicate 2007 reported an opening gross claims outstanding (prior-year comparative) of GBP 1,162.6m and recorded prior-year development during the calendar year equivalent to a favourable movement of GBP 33.6m (release), representing roughly a 2.9% release of opening gross claims reserves. The managing agent attributes this primarily to benign natural catastrophe experience and favourable attritional claims development, with part of the prior-year improvement relating to inherited business received via reinsurance to close.

data.data_quality_notes: Primary gross claims opening balance taken from Balance Sheet (explicit). No explicit GROSS prior-year movement figure was found; the report explicitly states a GBP 33.6m movement in the narrative/notes but this figure appears within a 'claims incurred, net of reinsurance' context and therefore is net of reinsurance. Chairman's statement also refers to a GBP 33.6m release. Due to absence of a clear gross prior-year movement note, the prior_year_development_gbp_m shown is the reported net figure (release) and has been flagged accordingly. There is minor OCR/wording inconsistency in the source text (both "releases to reserves" and "increases to reserves" appear in different sections). A gross claims development triangle is present (used for cross-checks) but contains an aggregate '2010 & Prior' column which is excluded from PYD calculations per rules and an RITC entry (2013 closure) that can distort comparisons.
